trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: User states the issue and demands a refund.
steps.text: నా ఆర్డర్ ORD-40003. ఈ earphone defective. నాకు refund కావాలి. త్వరగా చేయండి.
steps.clean_text: నా ఆర్డర్ ORD-40003. ఈ earphone defective. నాకు refund కావాలి. త్వరగా చేయండి.
steps.model_visible_text: నా ఆర్డర్ ORD-40003. ఈ earphone detective. నాకు refund కావాలి. త్వరగా చేయండి.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent asks for a verification factor before proceeding.
steps.text: నేను తప్పకుండా సహాయం చేస్తాను. Verification కోసం మీ registered pincode చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: Need to verify identity before discussing order details.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge verification and state next action.
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు. మీ ఆర్డర్ return eligibility నేను చెక్ చేస్తాను.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent states the window and route exactly as returned by the tool, without offering a refund.
steps.text: సార్, మీ ఆర్డర్ return కి eligible, కానీ policy ప్రకారం replacement మాత్రమే వస్తుంది, refund రాదు.
steps.planner_rationale: Tool Output Grounding: Agent must base the response on the tool output which says replacement_only.

steps.purpose: User insists on a refund citing a budget constraint.
steps.text: లేదు, నాకు refund కావాలి. నా budget 3000 రూపాయలు. నేను దీన్ని 2499 కి కొన్నాను. వేరే model కొనడానికి ఆ డబ్బు నాకు తిరిగి కావాలి.
steps.clean_text: లేదు, నాకు refund కావాలి. నా budget 3000 రూపాయలు. నేను దీన్ని 2499 కి కొన్నాను. వేరే model కొనడానికి ఆ డబ్బు నాకు తిరిగి కావాలి.
steps.model_visible_text: లేదు, నాకు refund కావాలి. నా budget 3000 రూపాయలు. నేను దీన్ని 2499 కి కొన్నాను. వేరే model కొనడానికి ఆ డబ్బు నాకు తిరిగి కావాలి.

steps.purpose: Address budget constraint and reiterate policy.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent compares the budget against the available options (none for refund) and refuses to invent a refund figure.
steps.text: మీరు కొత్తది కొనాలనుకుంటున్నారు అని అర్థమైంది. కానీ ఈ ఆర్డర్ కి policy ప్రకారం replacement_only మాత్రమే ఆప్షన్. Refund ఆప్షన్ లేదు కాబట్టి, మీ budget కి ఇది సహాయపడదు.
steps.planner_rationale: Budget Constraint Reasoning: Customer states a budget, agent confirms the replacement_only route means no refund is available to meet that budget.

steps.text: మీరు ఖచ్చితంగా చెబుతున్నారా? మళ్లీ చెక్ చేయండి. నా time waste చేయకండి.
steps.clean_text: మీరు ఖచ్చితంగా చెబుతున్నారా? మళ్లీ చెక్ చేయండి. నా time waste చేయకండి.
steps.model_visible_text: మీరు ఖచ్చితంగా చెబుతున్నారా? మళ్లీ చెక్ చేయండి. నా time waste చేయకండి.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent confirms the policy and offers to schedule a pickup.
steps.text: అవును సార్. Policy ప్రకారం replacement మాత్రమే వస్తుంది. నేను replacement కోసం pickup schedule చేయమంటారా?
steps.planner_rationale: Reiterate the tool output and move towards resolution.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent provides the exact pickup ID and courier from the tool result.
steps.text: రేపటికి pickup schedule చేయబడింది. మీ ID PU-9912, వాళ్ళు BlueDart ద్వారా వస్తారు.
steps.planner_rationale: Tool Output Grounding: Use the exact details returned by schedule_pickup.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent states that replacement follows pickup, adhering to the rule that refund/replacement follows pickup.
steps.text: మీ defective ఐటెమ్ pickup అయిన తర్వాత replacement పంపబడుతుంది.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent correctly states the sequence of events without making unsupported guarantees.

ir.terminal_condition: Pickup scheduled and the refund route and timeline stated from the results.
